items.title: Nancy Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: We were talking about television. Let’s just talk a couple more minutes, because we were starting to talk about the dramas. There was actually – there were two back in the ’60s, before Hawaii Five O. There was Burke’s Law in ’65 and then I Spy in ’66. So that would have been a Cosby thing?

Then came the 1970 Hawaii Five O, which you talked about, the death scene. Your character’s name, by the way, I think was Evie Jordan. Also that year was Room 222. Some of these I barely remember myself. ’72 was O’Hara: U.S. Treasury.
